title: OpenBao
subtitle: An open-source secrets manager with dynamic secrets, encryption and audit.

tiles.label: AppRole
tiles.says: AppRole authenticates machines with a role and secret ID.
tiles.detail: Automation obtains tokens without human credentials. Secret IDs can be single-use and short-lived.

tiles.label: Tokens & leases
tiles.says: Every token and secret carries a TTL and lease.
tiles.detail: Expiry and renewal limit blast radius. Revocation by lease cleans up everything issued.

tiles.label: Policies
tiles.says: Policies grant capabilities on paths and nothing else.
tiles.detail: Default deny and path-based ACLs give least privilege that can be reviewed as code.

tiles.label: KV engine
tiles.says: KV stores versioned secrets with rollback.
tiles.detail: Version history and soft delete protect against mistakes while keeping credentials out of repositories.

tiles.label: Transit
tiles.says: Transit encrypts data without exposing keys.
tiles.detail: Applications send plaintext and receive ciphertext, so key handling is centralised and rotatable.

tiles.label: PKI
tiles.says: The PKI engine issues short-lived certificates.
tiles.detail: Automated certificates reduce outages from expiry and support mutual TLS everywhere.

tiles.label: Encryption barrier
tiles.says: All data is encrypted before it reaches storage.
tiles.detail: Unseal keys protect the master key, so stolen disks reveal nothing.

tiles.label: Raft storage
tiles.says: Integrated Raft replicates data across nodes.
tiles.detail: One active leader and standbys provide high availability without an external database.

tiles.label: Audit devices
tiles.says: Every request is logged with sensitive values hashed.
tiles.detail: Tamper-evident logs give compliance teams evidence of who accessed what.
